text: this is not painting anything. or if it is. i dont see it i just see the normal texture atlas [Image #2]
resolution: Paint reworked across the lag, grid, bleed, and cross-model bugs. (1) Lag: dabs now accumulate in a ref with a throttled atlas re-bake (the cutout painter's clock) + a self-ticking ref-driven grid overlay, so painting/hovering never re-renders the viewport. (2) Pinstripes + paint-lands-far-from-cursor + zoom-decouple were ONE root cause: a coarse fixed paint grid over a finely-packed (1024-texel) atlas meant each cell straddled many faces' UV slots, scattering colour across faces. Fixed by making the atlas ITSELF the fixed grid — textureizeScene gains fitTexels so the packed atlas is ~model-independent (paintGridCells target), grid = packed atlas = one cell per padded texel in ONE face's slot, no bleed. (3) Cross-model carryover: the studio:tex twig is global, so the texture+paint buffer now reset when the open model changes. textureAtlasPx 256 to 512 for crisper cells; interpolated strokes + distinct brush sizes fill continuously. NOTE: due to the shared git index across parallel sessions, this code landed in commit b3bef7ec8 (another session's commit swept up my staged files) plus 2889db1d4 — the code is in HEAD and verified (textureize 10/10, meshPaint 6/6, bundles clean).
